item.title: John Carlson and Justin Sourdif miss Capitals game against Sharks due to injury
item.description: The Washington Capitals will be without veteran defenseman John Carlson and rookie center Justin Sourdif against the San Jose Sharks on Wednesday night. Carlson has an upper-body injury, while Sourdif is out with a lower-body injury. Carlson, 35, participated in the team’s warmup skate ahead of the action but did not dress in the game.
